highlights: Within days of its release, several of the company's key partners, including Microsoft, Google and Amazon, reported quarterly results that added fuel to existing market jitters around the artificial intelligence buildout. "Everybody's still full steam ahead on AI, but all the things around it took an interesting turn this week," Daniel Newman, CEO at Futurum Group, told CNBC in an interview on Friday. In its prospectus on Monday, the AI company disclosed a net loss for the first half of the year of $80 billion, alongside hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of compute commitments and more than 90 pages of risk factors. Anthropic gets much of its capacity from Amazon, Google and SpaceX, but it also relies on neoclouds for some compute as it races to expand as quickly as possible. And Oracle, one of the biggest spenders on AI data centers, said at its investor day on Wednesday that it will limit additional fundraising in the coming years to $20 billion, and will turn cash flow positive in the second half of next fiscal year.

highlights: # AI boom hits a wall on Wall Street as OpenAI cuts fundraising target while Meta gets a credit warning over its cash flow, spending and monetization. The seemingly endless gusher of capital that’s been showered on Silicon Valley during the AI boom may be coming to an end soon as Wall Street pushes back on massive spending plans. Following a brutal selloff in tech stocks over the past week, OpenAI slashed the target on its latest fundraising round to $20 billion from $30 billion, sources told the *Financial Times*. Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic filed an S-1 on Monday that showed revenue has soared and its cash flow turned positive in the first half of this year. Of course, other hyperscalers are spending heavily and running cash deficits, but S&P also said Meta’s ability to monetize its AI investments is more limited than that of its peers.

latest.summary: OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion amid a selloff in tech stocks ​driven by AI worries, the Financial Times reported on Friday, ‌citing people with knowledge of ...
highlights: OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion amid a selloff in tech stocks ​driven by AI worries, the Financial Times reported on Friday, ‌citing people with knowledge of the matter. The ChatGPT maker is now seeking about $20 billion and its desired valuation has dropped to $1.25 trillion from $1.4 billion, the report ​said. OpenAI set a Friday deadline for investors to commit to ​the funding round, but the "first close" is expected to raise ⁠less than $20 billion after some investors reduced their allocations, it ​added. A consortium of UAE investors that includes state-backed technology fund MGX is ​expected to be the largest participant in the round, and as part of the deal, OpenAI would gain the option to lease newly developed computing capacity in ​the region, the newspaper added. Venture capital firms including Founders Fund, Coatue, ​Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also expected to participate, according to the ‌report.

latest.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round - CNBC
latest.summary: OpenAI is seeking to raise up to $20 billion in a new funding round, CNBC confirmed on Saturday, paring back its earlier target of up to $30 billion. The funding round is still in progress and has not...
highlights: OpenAI is seeking to raise up to $20 billion in a new funding round, CNBC confirmed on Saturday, paring back its earlier target of up to $30 billion. The funding round is still in progress and has not closed, so the figures are subject to change, a person directly familiar with the deal told CNBC, asking to remain unnamed as they were not authorized to discuss the details publicly. The Financial Times first reported that OpenAI had reduced its target for the round by $10 billion, and said the company would seek a post-money valuation of $1.25 trillion. According to FT, the ChatGPT developer set a Friday deadline for investors to commit to ​the newest round, with some investors opting to reduce their allocations. News that the ChatGPT developer slashed its funding round follows a week when investors asked whether big tech firms' spending on AI, especially to build out data centers and snap up GPUs, will deliver adequate returns.

latest.summary: # OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round. OpenAI was previously reported to be raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation, and then at a $1.25 trillion valuation, ahead of a plann...
highlights: # OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round. OpenAI was previously reported to be raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation, and then at a $1.25 trillion valuation, ahead of a planned IPO. But The Financial Times reported Friday that the company has subsequently lowered its funding target to $20 billion, with a first close that’s expected to be even lower than that. A subsequent retail offering for wealthy individuals could bring the total funding amount to the $20 billion target. A follow-up story in The Wall Street Journal offered more details, namely that the company has secured $11 billion so far, and that its fundraising efforts had met with a “tepid” response from some large investors. The company’s reported funding challenges could be blamed, in part, on bad timing, as Wall Street investors have become wary of heavy AI infrastructure spending, leading to a major sell off of tech stocks.

latest.title: Microsoft AI chief says AI is not conscious and we should keep it that way - Business Insider
latest.summary: Mustafa Suleyman said in a lengthy X post on Sunday that AI models currently don't have consciousness and that developers should keep it that way. "If it is possible, based on everything I know, devel...
highlights: Mustafa Suleyman said in a lengthy X post on Sunday that AI models currently don't have consciousness and that developers should keep it that way. "If it is possible, based on everything I know, developing conscious AIs would be reckless, and we should not build them," Suleyman said. "We AI developers have no right whatsoever to bring a new species of conscious beings into the world, even if some people may want to do it with AI welfare as a top priority," he said. "The other 8 billion conscious human beings on the planet have not signed up to this experiment and their moral rights, safety, and welfare are what we have an obligation to protect first and foremost.". Last April, Anthropic started a research program to investigate and prepare to navigate "model welfare." In a blog post, the startup questioned whether developers should be concerned about models' potential consciousness and experiences.

month.summary: 单纯从芯片视角来看，曦云C600在国产AI芯片中是颇具代表性的。这颗芯片是去年世界人工智能大会(WAIC)期间沐曦发布的：自研XCORE 1.5架构，144GB HBM3e显存、3.6TB/s显存带宽；算力标称值：INT8 2000TOPS、FP8 1000TFLOPS、FP16/BF16～500TFLOPS(FP32算力数值各来源给出的值不同，可能与不同产品形态有关)；采用MetaXLink实现...
highlights: 单纯从芯片视角来看，曦云C600在国产AI芯片中是颇具代表性的

这颗芯片是去年世界人工智能大会(WAIC)期间沐曦发布的：自研XCORE 1.5架构，144GB HBM3e显存、3.6TB/s显存带宽；算力标称值：INT8 2000TOPS、FP8 1000TFLOPS、FP16/BF16～500TFLOPS(FP32算力数值各来源给出的值不同，可能与不同产品形态有关)；采用MetaXLink实现多卡互连，单卡双向带宽320GB/s(来源于MirrorFrog，该值可能不准确)，支持2～64卡拓扑
部分媒体在报道中称曦云C600对标的是NVIDIA H100——从官方标称算力数值实际上无法直接得出两者间的关联，何况标称峰值算力数值并不能反映实际任务负载中的性能表现，更不用说上升到系统层面时的整体算力水平——沐曦自身似乎也并未在公开场合明确过C600的竞争对手是H100，反倒在IPO首轮问询回复中将尚未问世的C700视作H100对标对象

highlights: 5. Google’s Gemini 4 Argon back at frontier: Google scrambled back to the frontier with its latest Google Gemini 4 Argon model. Independent tests are less generous: the Artificial Analysis Index has Argon at 53, tied with Astra, behind Opus 5.5 and Meta’s Muse Wonder Full, as I laid out in AI-RTZ [...] laid out in AI-RTZ #1238. Google is pricing to win, at about a fifth of Astra and Fable for now, and it landed a day after Meta’s Wonder. Two frontier launches in two days. My take, from ARD #183: expect frontier leadership to keep ebbing and flowing, in an infinite game, not a race. Google is unique, with a full vertical stack from chips to billions of users, so it can afford to arrive late, and cheap. month.summary:
机器人硬件之间还存在明显差异。

不同厂商的机械臂长度、关节布局、灵巧手结构和自由度并不一致，同一个动作在不同机器人上的执行方式可能完全不同。

即使采集到大量操作数据，也需要解决不同本体之间的数据适配问题。
